title: Requested feature
body:
Hey dev! I love your app, it has everything i need. 

I suggest a feature where on the Streak Widget, the background of the widget has a visual depending on the lenght of the streak (exactly like the chess.com app widget). For example first milestone is 7 days, the background changes, then 30, 60, 90 days etc..

Let me know if you would add this feature it would be cool and improve the UX. 

Have a great day.
author: Pin8al
